title: Urgent: Marketplace payout tax breakouts & invoice allocation (AWS / GCP / Azure)
text:
Urgent: Marketplace payout tax breakouts & invoice allocation (AWS / GCP / Azure)

["From: Acme Analytics Finance <ap@acme-analytics.com>\\nTo: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2026-11-20T09:15:00-08:00\\nSubject: Payouts missing VAT breakouts / GCP withholding on Oct invoice\\n\\nHi Mina,\\n\\nWe're reconciling the October marketplace payouts and we see two issues:\\n- GCP charged a withholding VAT (18%) on the Oct 31 invoice line for our eu-de region, but the invoice summary doesn't show a VAT breakout for the regional payouts.\\n- Total payout amount on the October remittance doesn't match the gross invoice lines after VAT adjustments — it looks like AWS and Azure used different allocation keys.\\n\\nCan you send (1) the detailed per-transaction tax/vat breakup you have for Oct payouts, (2) any corrected invoices from marketplace partners, or (3) guidance on how Redwood allocates VAT across marketplace settlements? We need this for our AP to release the withheld amount.\\n\\nAttaching: acme_payment_schedule.pdf (payment schedule), acme_oct_payouts.csv (sample rows).\\n\\nThanks,\\nLisa Chen\\nHead of Finance — Acme Analytics\\nattachments: acme_payment_schedule.pdf (pdf), acme_oct_payouts.csv (csv)\\n", 'From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>\\nTo: Acme Analytics Finance <ap@acme-analytics.com>\\nCc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2026-11-20T11:03:00-08:00\\nSubject: Re: Payouts missing VAT breakouts / GCP withholding on Oct invoice\\n\\nLisa — thanks for flagging this.\\n\\nI\'m looping in Karthik (marketplace billing) and Olga (tax) to pull the raw transaction-level detail. Karthik, can you pull the Oct payout export for Acme and include the marketplace-side VAT tags (region, tax_rate, tax_amount, allocation_key)? We suspect a mix of \\"gross-based\\" vs \\"net-based\\" allocation across partners created the mismatch.\\n\\nOlga — could you confirm whether Redwood\'s settlement flow should have produced a separate VAT line on the customer-facing invoice or if partner platforms sometimes withhold and report VAT differently? Acme is requesting corrected invoices or a supporting breakdown to unblock their AP.\\n\\nI\'ll also open tickets with AWS/GCP/Azure if we need corrected marketplace invoices.\\n\\nThanks,\\nMina Haddad\\nRevenue Ops Manager, Redwood Inference\\nattachments: none\\n', "From: AWS Marketplace Billing <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>\\nTo: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>\\nCc: GCP Partner Ops <partner-ops@gcp.com>, Azure Marketplace Finance <marketplace_finance@microsoft.com>\\nDate: 2026-11-21T07:42:00-08:00\\nSubject: RE: Payouts missing VAT breakouts / GCP withholding on Oct invoice\\n\\nHi team —\\n\\nThanks for the ping. We looked up the account-level invoice for Acme (partner id 987654). For EU customers in the eu-de tax jurisdiction, our system applies a withholding tax where the buyer is required to withhold and remit VAT locally when the buyer does not have a VAT-registered seller. That withholding is recorded on the invoice as a consolidated adjustment; it may not always show as a per-transaction VAT line in the default export.\\n\\nI've attached the processed invoice we sent to Acme (aws_invoice_20261031.pdf). Ticket: AMZ-TP-33214 has been opened to request a per-line tax breakdown; expected response within 5 business days.\\n\\nIf Redwood is the registered seller and has provided EU VAT information, we can reissue invoices without the withholding. Please confirm the seller-vat status in your platform.\\n\\nRegards,\\nPriya R. — AWS Marketplace Billing\\nattachments: aws_invoice_20261031.pdf (pdf)\\n", 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>\\nTo: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2026-11-24T10:20:00-08:00\\nSubject: Internal: Proposed reconciliation steps for Acme — Oct payouts\\n\\nTeam —\\n\\nI pulled the marketplace transaction dump and attached a trimmed export: 2026Q4-marketplace-detail.csv (contains txn_id, partner, region, gross_amount, marketplace_fee, tax_code, tax_amount, allocation_key). Observations:\\n- GCP entries show \\"withholding_vat\\" in tax_code for eu-de for ~18% of gross lines.\\n- AWS has a consolidated \\"tax_adjustment\\" flag for several settlement batches which removes VAT from gross before payout.\\n- Azure lines include VAT as separate line items but use a different allocation_key that maps to \\"platform_fee_first\\" rather than \\"pro-rata-customer\\".\\n\\nProposed plan:\\n1) Produce a per-deal reconciliation with (a) gross invoice lines, (b) marketplace tax breakouts, (c) Redwood allocation to customer payouts. Use the attached CSV to generate the journal mapping.\\n2) Where partners withheld VAT (GCP/AWS), request corrected invoice reissuance if Redwood is the registered seller.\\n3) For Acme: create a one-time credit or settlement adjustment if allocation mismatch created underpayment — target communication 11/30.\\n\\nAditya — please prepare the GL mapping for our finance team (journal entries + reversals) and confirm whether we should issue a customer credit or process a retrospective payout.\\n\\n-Karthik\\nattachments: 2026Q4-marketplace-detail.csv (csv)\\n', "From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>\\nTo: Acme Analytics Finance <ap@acme-analytics.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2026-11-26T14:08:00-08:00\\nSubject: Re: Payouts missing VAT breakouts / GCP withholding on Oct invoice — tax position\\n\\nHi Lisa / team,\\n\\nThanks for the detail, and thanks Mina/Karthik for pulling the export. Short summary from a tax perspective:\\n- If Redwood is the registered EU seller for Acme's transactions, marketplace platforms should not withhold VAT; instead they should pass-through the VAT amounts and Redwood (or the seller) is responsible for remitting.\\n- If Redwood is not the registered seller in the partner's profile, the platform may treat the buyer as the withholding agent.\\n\\nAction items for Acme (confirm):\\n1) Please confirm whether Redwood appeared as the tax-registered seller on your marketplace purchase records (seller_tax_id or seller_vat).\\n2) If not, provide the buyer-side withholding certificate so we can request corrected invoices or refund of withheld VAT.\\n\\nI'll draft the customer-facing note to Acme explaining the legal basis and the path to recover the withheld amount; if partners reissue invoices we will coordinate the settlement adjustment.\\n\\nBest,\\nOlga Petrov\\nTax & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference\\nattachments: none\\n", "From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>\\nTo: Acme Analytics Finance <ap@acme-analytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2026-11-30T16:42:00-08:00\\nSubject: Re: Payouts missing VAT breakouts / GCP withholding on Oct invoice — reconciliation plan and timeline\\n\\nTeam / Lisa — quick update and next steps:\\n\\n1) Karthik: we've validated the differential allocation keys across partners and prepared the per-transaction CSV (sent 11/24).\\n2) Olga: tax position confirmed — waiting on Acme to confirm seller_tax_id.\\n3) AWS has opened ticket AMZ-TP-33214 (per-line breakout) and GCP has ticket GCP-78921 (withholding escalation).\\n4) Aditya: finance to decide credit vs. payout adjustment by EOD 11/30; if finance chooses payout adjustment we will require GL entries submitted to Procurement/Payments by 12/03.\\n\\nFor Acme: if you can confirm Redwood's tax registration on your marketplace order records (seller_vat or seller_tax_id) by EOD tomorrow, we will push partners for corrected invoices. If partners decline reissuance, Redwood will propose a one-time settlement adjustment and/or credit to refund the withheld amount.\\n\\nI'll follow up with a combined statement and ledger extract (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c) and will update HubSpot HS-1234567 with the action items. Expect final customer communication by 11/30 close of business.\\n\\nThanks — Mina\\nMina Haddad\\nRevenue Ops Manager | Redwood Inference\\nPhone: +1 415-555-0199\\nattachments: 2026Q4-marketplace-detail.csv (csv)\\n"]
